name: wp
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;let m=null;S.traverse(o=>{if(o.name==='main:dctWall')m=o;});const g=m.geometry;g.computeBoundingBox();const bb=g.boundingBox;const o=[];for(const z of [-30,-15,9.4,25,45]){const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-86,1.7,z),new T.Vector3(0,1,0));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true);o.push('z='+z+' -> '+(h[0]?h[0].object.name+'@y'+h[0].point.y.toFixed(2):'SKY'));}return JSON.stringify({wallBB:[bb.min.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)),bb.max.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(1))],up:o})})()
